title: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk Manga to End in 12th Volume Next Spring
content: Mika Yamamori announced in the author's notes from the 11th In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga volume on Friday that the series will end in next volume next spring. The wraparound jacket band on 11th volume also announced that the series has reached 8.2 million copies in circulation globally.
author: ANN

title: Star Detective Precure! Film Assembles You and Idol Precure, Wonderful Precure! in 2 Trailers
content: The staff for Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu ( Star Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of 2 People) — the film for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise — presented the latest two trailers and a new still on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Orb, 100 Meters Manga Creator Uoto to Launch 2 New Manga Series
content: Orb: On the Movements of the Earth artist Uoto announced two new manga series on Friday and Saturday. Hallucination Meat will launch in Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine. The launch date is still to be determined, but Uoto thinks it will be this year.
author: ANN

title: Boruto Is Finally Returning From Hiatus With a Major Twist No One Expected
content: Boruto is returning with a new installment in the upcoming issue of V Jump after taking a break last month to celebrate the third anniversary of the series. In August 2026, the series turned three years old, and to mark its third anniversary, it took a break instead of having a grand celebration.

title: 'Grotesqqque' Reveals Supporting Cast, Trailer for "Yoroshiku★Shoujo" Segment
content: The Aniplex One Focus 2026 event revealed supporting cast for the Grotesqqque original anime movie and a trailer for its Yoroshiku★Shoujo segment on Saturday. The three-story omnibus movie will premiere in Japanese theaters on November 6.
